associations.rationale: The declaration defines the derivations as a Lie subalgebra of the endomorphism Lie algebra, directly packaging closure under commutators and the resulting Lie-algebra structure.
The application formula identifies the Lie bracket of two derivations with their commutator, supporting the closure encoded by the Lie-subalgebra definition.
The Lie equivalence identifies the Lie subalgebra with the existing derivation type, but it is an auxiliary comparison rather than the definition asserting closure.
